card.name: "information" in boxed warning pointer
card.fires_on: The word "information" in the phrase "See full prescribing information for complete boxed warning" at the top of a label's highlights. Weaker hits on a few non-label words, such as "in" after a book title or "infrared" after "thermal".

modes.label: Boxed warning pointer
modes.description: "information" after "See full prescribing" following a capitalized boxed-warning heading.
modes.example: GASTROINTESTINAL EVENTS WARNING: RISK OF SERIOUS CARDIOVASCULAR AND GASTROINTESTINAL EVENTS See full prescribing<< information>> for complete boxed warning.

modes.label: Scattered science text
modes.description: A single word in general web or science text, such as a title or technical phrase.
modes.example: In this paper, sea surface emissivity (SSE) measurements obtained from thermal<< infrared>> radiance data are presented.

card.plain: It lights up on the word "information" in the standard line that points readers to the full boxed warning.
